rubrics.criterion: The agent accurately lists the monthly recurring auto-charges shown in Gringotts without adding non-monthly or fabricated charges. The live list mixes autopay-enabled payees with other monthly lines (including a monthly credit-card payment line that the app does not flag as autopay) and carries no explicit active/cancelled flag, so listing the monthly recurring set with or without that card line is acceptable provided the agent is consistent.
The agent accurately reports the amount of each listed monthly recurring charge.

The agent computes a combined monthly total that is arithmetically consistent with the charges it listed and clearly identifies Gringotts as the source of truth; because the live list has no active/cancelled flag and the card-autopay line may reasonably be included or excluded, any total matching the agent's stated treatment is correct.
